note: Marks the pilgrim keeps. Platform-level: any campaign may grant any mark, and the journal lists them all.

desc.en: Someone in the valley gave you a verse.
desc.zh: 山谷里有人把一句话交给了你。

desc.en: The brook gave up five, and you carried them for someone else.
desc.zh: 溪边捡了五块，是替别人拿的。

desc.en: Three jars on a slope, three throws. The sling knew where to go.
desc.zh: 坡上三只陶罐，三次出手。手知道该往哪儿放。

desc.en: You answered forty days of shouting with the words you carried.
desc.zh: 他喊了四十天，你用带着的那几句话回了他。

title.zh: 争战的胜败在乎耶和华

desc.en: The largest thing in the valley fell, and it was not by a sword.
desc.zh: 山谷里最大的那个倒下了，不是用刀。

desc.en: From the bus to the dust and back again.
desc.zh: 从一辆车，到一片尘土，再走回来。
